findings.message:
Inserting markup via the following properties or methods will soon no longer be permitted. The only supported way to do so is the Sanitizer API (Element.setHTML(), Thunderbird 148+). Please also consider alternatives to (re-)building the live DOM (use textContent, a <template>, or CSS to show and hide existing elements).
Read more: https://webextension-api.thunderbird.net/en/mv3/guides/innerHTML.html.
